test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Blitz
solution:
The **correct answer** is: **'Obtuse'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Blitz'** typically refers to a sudden, concentrated effort or campaign, sometimes used to refer to a fast, intensive military attack. (झटके से हमला).

 
 
• **For example-** "The advertising blitz for the new product made everyone anxious for its release".
 
 
 
• **'Obtuse'** indicates slowness or dullness, particularly in understanding or comprehending, hence making it an antonym in a broad contextual sense. (मंद).
 
 
• **For example-** "He was obtuse to the obvious hint she dropped about wanting to go to dinner".
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is** 'Option 2'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Harm' **means to cause hurt or damage.(नुकसान).
 
• **'Kill' **means to cause the death of a living organism. (मारना).
 
• **'Attack' **refers to an aggressive action against someone or something.(हमला).
